# Open Frontier

> An empty continent and cheap pioneers: the land rush starts on turn one. Land is cheap; holding it is not. Walls come dear, and every new town strains the peace.

**Play:** [Skirmish](https://tessera4x.com/#world=skirmish&seed=2213474369&) · [Full game](https://tessera4x.com/#world=custom&seed=2213474369&) · or download [mod.json](mod.json)  
**Author:** Tessera4X · **Changes:** 14
<!-- head:end -->

## How it plays

A Pioneer (the Settler, renamed) costs 60 production instead of 106 and a
Worker 50 instead of 70, and the first techs on the farming line come cheaper.
Your capital sends out its second and third cities in a little over half the
usual time, and so do your rivals'.

Every new city still costs 3 of your 9 starting happiness, so the question
each turn is when to stop. Each Monument gives +1 happiness to make room.
Walls cost 130, so a thin frontier is an exposed one. On the skirmish's Tiny
map the land runs out early, and borders meet sooner than you're used to.

## Balance Lab

48 machine-only skirmishes, the Lab's own worlds (a Tiny map, three civilizations, 60 turns), each played twice: by the game's own rules and by this mod. Run on Tessera4X 1.3.

| | Game's own rules | This mod |
|---|---|---|
| Games ended on score at the final turn | 48 of 48 | 48 of 48 |
| Cities per civilization at the end | 6.1 | 7.0 |
| Score per civilization | 343 | 420 |
| Soldiers raised per game | 61.2 | 71.7 |
| Wonders standing per game | 3.5 | 5.8 |
| Civilizations knocked out | 1 of 144 | 0 of 144 |
| Pioneers (Settlers) raised per game | 20.8 | 26.1 |
| Workers raised per game | 16.6 | 22.3 |
| Monuments standing per game | 7.9 | 13.4 |
| Walls standing per game | 0.4 | 1.0 |

The land rush is real for the machine too: a quarter more Pioneers, a seventh more cities, and with them over two more wonders a game. Nobody was knocked out.
